title: [finding] platform-readings: the container REST read path returns issue and comment bodies with every bare `#N` expanded to `owner/repo#N`, so a body rewrite built on a REST read writes the expansion into the stored text
body:
Filing gate ①, as `finding` + `tooling`: a platform-reading fact the fact table lacks, with a measured consequence for every seat that rewrites a card body from a REST read. Filed by the director seat, summon #45, `session_01Lg6GQ4xjqmvEzYv78d6H7i` (`os-justin`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:skills` seat — one fact line in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (the REST read side) and the matching read-side pointer in `rest-channel.md`. ⛔ No new gate (「新增门禁默认否」): a seat-side habit is enough — collapse before a body rewrite, or prove the fetched length against the last known raw length.

**reach:** measured in this container at 02:3x UTC on 2026-10-20. `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/comments/6279597228` (this seat's own opening marker, sent through the relay with 35 bare `#N` references and read back by the relay as identical, 4,673 bytes) returns a body of 5,667 bytes carrying 40 `objectstack-ai/objectstack#N` and 3 bare references, under four `Accept` values (`application/vnd.github+json`, `application/vnd.github.raw+json`, `application/json`, `application/vnd.github.v3.raw`). The director seat post #12708 reads 17,699 bytes with 117 expansions against its raw 14,657. Control: at this summon's opening (23:38 UTC, 2026-10-19) the same path returned seven card bodies with 0 expansions (#24638, #24610, #24646, #24591, #24525, #24692, objectstack-ai/objectui#13099), so the behaviour switched within one session with no seat action. The relay's own read-back on the runner is unaffected. Who is affected: any seat that fetches a body over REST in a CCR container and sends it back through `post-stamped --body` — the stored text gains the expansion on every bare reference, and the write is reported identical because it is: the mutation happened on the read.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, closed included): "REST read body expands bare issue reference into owner/repo#N proxy rewrite stored body differs read-back" → 22 hits; the nearest are closed platform-reading findings on the WRITE side (#18254, #18249, #20360 on footer cells; #18350, #18197 on the token class). None on the read side's reference expansion. No open card.

**What done looks like:** `platform-readings.md` carries one line under the REST reads: a REST-read body may arrive with bare `#N` expanded to `owner/repo#N` (proxy side, seen to switch within a session); a body rewrite built on it collapses `objectstack-ai/<this repo>#N` back to `#N` or proves the fetched length against the raw length first. `rest-channel.md` 读侧 points to that line. The reconstruction this seat used (collapse the own-repo prefix: 17,699 → 14,657 bytes, the raw length read at opening) is recorded on #12708, ledger block C 6281946060.
